title: Fruit Slash
shortDescription: Swipe to slice flying fruit, chain combos, and never hit a bomb.
description: Watermelons, oranges, apples, lemons, kiwis and plums come flying up from below. Swipe across them to slice them in half, cut three or more in one swipe for a combo bonus, and stay away from the bombs. Let three fruit fall and the game is over. The fruit comes faster, and the bombs more often, the longer you last.
howToPlay: Swipe across flying fruit to slice it.
Slice three or more fruit in one swipe for a combo bonus.
Never cut a bomb: it ends the game on the spot.
Every fruit that falls uncut costs one of your three lives.

keys: Mouse: hold the button and swipe
